The stronger story is now clear. The tools have gained more control features, so the essay should not argue that agents lack all of this machinery. It should argue that long running delegation creates a separate job: approve what counts as done, keep control through failure, and accept only the result that produced the evidence. The stricter completion design came later as those needs exposed a trust problem.
